title: Memory atom frontmatter (markdown source)
description: Validates ONLY the YAML frontmatter block of a memory .md atom. The markdown body is intentionally NOT schema-validated — body shape is enforced by the heading-allowlist lint. additionalProperties:false makes stray metadata a hard author-time error.

slug.description: Machine key; must equal the filename stem.

title.description: Human-readable atom title (used in catalog + panel).

tldr.description: One-sentence abstract; first-pass filter in the lean session payload.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence abstract; the 'should I self-pull this?' signal in the catalog.

tags.description: Free-form topic tags for catalog filtering.

last_updated.description: ISO date of last content change (set by product-engineer at CLOSURE).

release_origin.description: Release ID that last modified this atom.
